cohort: 206 patients undergoing caesarean section due to meconium-stained amniotic fluid at Shivpuri government medical college, India
finding: Meconium staining is common in term and prolonged pregnancies, and cardiotocography is useful in monitoring foetal status and improving neonatal outcome in patients with meconium-stained liquor.
gest_age: > 40 weeks in the majority (56%) of patients
followup_time: 24 to 48 hours for SNCU stays in 56% of cases
